f.title: ICSR validity: complete the four sections (patient, suspected medicine, reaction, reporter)
f.statement: The four sections that validate an individual case report are: (1) an identifiable patient (patient initials, sex, weight, age at time of reaction or date of birth); (2) suspected medicine (name as INN and brand name, strength, dose and frequency, dosage form, route of administration, indication, duration of use with start and stop dates, batch number especially for vaccines); (3) suspected adverse reaction (description, expectedness against the approved product information, seriousness, dates the reaction started and stopped, relevant tests/laboratory data if available); (4) an identifiable reporter (name or initials, address, contact details, qualification if a healthcare professional).
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.quote:
The four sections to validate the individual case report (ICSR) are as follow:
 Section 1: An identifiable patient  Section 2: Suspected medicine
 1. Patient initials 1. Name (INN and brand name)
 2. Sex 2. Strength (concentration)
 3. Weight 3. Dose, Frequency
 4. Age at time of reaction or date of birth 4. Dosage form
 Section 3: Suspected adverse reaction 5. Route of administration
 1. Description of the reaction 6. Indication for use
 2. Expectedness of the reaction (in accordance 7. Duration of use, date started, date stopped
 with the approved product information) 8. Batch number (especially for vaccines)
 3. Seriousness of the reaction
 4. Date the reaction started, stopped
 5. attributed to adverse reaction
 6. Relevant tests/laboratory data (if available)
 Section 4: An identifiable reporter
 1. Name, initials
 2. Address
 3. Contact details
 4. Qualification (if healthcare professional)
